'''Sonic beam projectors''' were large mounted weapons utilized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Stafuv Rahz]] had one assembled as a part of a plot to execute students from [[Harix]], in the hope that the act would draw out key members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
